PSYCHOKINESIS_POWER.title: Psychokinesis
PSYCHOKINESIS_POWER.description: Gain +1 whenever you draw a Curse, deal damage (per hit/target), take damage (per hit), or apply [gold]Grudge[/gold] (per target). Playing an Attack or Skill with Attack/Block/Heal immediately spends half (rounded up) to empower those values by that amount.
PSYCHOKINESIS_POWER.smartDescription: Gain +1 whenever you draw a Curse, deal or take damage (per hit), or apply [gold]Grudge[/gold]. Playing an Attack or Skill with Attack/Block/Heal spends half (rounded up) to empower those values by that amount. (Current: [blue]{Amount}[/blue])
HEXER_GRUDGE_TIP.title: Grudge
HEXER_GRUDGE_TIP.description: Total stacks of Specific Debuffs ([gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Frail[/gold], [gold]Shrink[/gold], and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]) on a unit. Thorns, Poison, Doom, and Strength loss do not count.
HEXER_EXORCISE_TIP.title: Exorcise
HEXER_EXORCISE_TIP.description: Randomly remove up to N stacks of [gold]Grudge[/gold] (Weak, Frail, Shrink, Vulnerable) from the target; for each stack removed, it loses 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] (not counted as Grudge).
HEXER_BLESSING_TIP.title: Blessing
HEXER_BLESSING_TIP.description: Randomly remove up to N stacks of [gold]Grudge[/gold] (Weak, Frail, Shrink, Vulnerable) from an ally; for each stack removed, they gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold].
EXORCISED_STRENGTH_LOSS_POWER.title: Exorcised
EXORCISED_STRENGTH_LOSS_POWER.descriptio: Deals less attack damage. (Does not count as a debuff or Grudge.)
EXORCISED_STRENGTH_LOSS_POWER.smartDescr: Deals [blue]{Amount}[/blue] less attack damage. (Does not count as a debuff or Grudge.)
ABYSSAL_GAZE_POWER.title: Abyssal Gaze
ABYSSAL_GAZE_POWER.description: Enemies with more than 5 total stacks of [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] have their Weak and Vulnerable effects doubled.
ABYSSAL_GAZE_POWER.smartDescription: Enemies with more than 5 total stacks of [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] have their Weak and Vulnerable effects doubled.
MIND_OVERLOAD_POWER.title: Mind Overload
MIND_OVERLOAD_POWER.description: Your [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] cost per empowered card is fixed at 1 (empowerment bonus still equals half your Psychokinesis, rounded up).
MIND_OVERLOAD_POWER.smartDescription: Your [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] cost per empowered card is fixed at 1 (empowerment bonus still equals half your Psychokinesis, rounded up).
ECHOING_BELLS_POWER.title: Echoing Bells
ECHOING_BELLS_POWER.description: Whenever a [gold]Curse[/gold] or [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] and deal damage to ALL enemies.
ECHOING_BELLS_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever a [gold]Curse[/gold] or [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
GRUDGE_SIPHON_POWER.title: Grudge Siphon
GRUDGE_SIPHON_POWER.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Grudge[/gold] to an enemy, deal damage to it.
GRUDGE_SIPHON_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you apply [gold]Grudge[/gold] to an enemy, deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to it.
CURSED_SANCTUARY_POWER.title: Cursed Sanctuary
CURSED_SANCTUARY_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, add 1 [gold]Ephemeral Hex[/gold] to your hand and gain [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
CURSED_SANCTUARY_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, add 1 [gold]Ephemeral Hex[/gold] to your hand and gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
BLIND_SEER_FORM_POWER.title: Blind Seer Form
BLIND_SEER_FORM_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, apply [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL units, and gain [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
BLIND_SEER_FORM_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL units, and gain 3x[blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
HEX_LINK_POWER.title: Hex Link
HEX_LINK_POWER.description: Whenever an ally deals damage to an enemy, gain [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
HEX_LINK_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever an ally deals damage to an enemy, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
RETAIN_PSYCHOKINESIS_BONUS_POWER.title: Condensed Will
RETAIN_PSYCHOKINESIS_BONUS_POWER.descrip: This turn, empowering Attacks, Block, or Heal does not spend [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
RETAIN_PSYCHOKINESIS_BONUS_POWER.smartDe: This turn, empowering Attacks, Block, or Heal does not spend [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
UNENDING_GRUDGE_POWER.title: Unending Grudge
UNENDING_GRUDGE_POWER.description: Whenever you cleanse a stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] via [gold]Exorcise[/gold] or [gold]Blessing[/gold], gain [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold].
UNENDING_GRUDGE_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you cleanse a stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] via [gold]Exorcise[/gold] or [gold]Blessing[/gold], gain 2x[blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] and 2x[blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
VESSEL_OF_CURSES_POWER.title: Vessel of Curses
VESSEL_OF_CURSES_POWER.description: Whenever you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold], gain [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] and draw 1 card.
VESSEL_OF_CURSES_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold], gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] and draw 1 card.
ASCENDANT_MEDIUM_POWER.title: Ascendant Medium
ASCENDANT_MEDIUM_POWER.description: Whenever you spend [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] on an Attack, gain [gold]Strength[/gold]; on a Skill, gain [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
ASCENDANT_MEDIUM_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you spend [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] on an Attack, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]; on a Skill, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
